newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER BATTING FIRST AGAINST BOLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER BATTING FIRST AGAINST BOLAND.

text.p: Border captain Pieter Strydom won the toss and elected to bat first on the opening day of their Supersport series cricket match against Boland at Buffalo Park on Friday.
Border - Brad White, Piet Botha, Bouwer du Plessis, Peter Kirsten, Mark Boucher, Pieter Strydom (captain), Steven Pope, Vasbert Drakes, Ian Howell, Peter Emslie, Makhaya Ntini.
Boland - Andrew Wessels, Lloyd Ferreira, Wayne Trutter, Kenny Jackson (captain), Elton Williams, Andrew Wylie, Riaan Oosthuizen, Chrisjan Vorster, Claude Henderson, Henry Williams, Charl Willouby.
